messages.content: Before we book Boston, compare the 8:05 Friday flight with the cheaper one that moved up. Then recheck the Revere room, the full total, and whether that Tuesday airport ride is actually realistic.

The original JetBlue nonstop leaves ORD at 8:05 a.m. Friday January 22 and arrives BOS at 11:23 a.m. It is now $1,047 total for three. The other nonstop leaves at 6:55 a.m. and arrives at 10:13 a.m.; it is $894 total. Both return on the selected Tuesday flight, BOS-ORD at 7:10-9:13 a.m. The earlier outbound saves $153 and gives you 70 more minutes in Boston.
Same fare conditions on both? And make sure that $894 is for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen together, not per person.

Yes. The $894 is the combined airfare for all three travelers, including taxes. Both are Blue fares: nonrefundable, no change fee, but any fare difference applies. If canceled before departure, the value is issued as JetBlue travel credit under the fare rules. Checked bags and advance seat upgrades are not included in that total.
Take the 6:55. Now verify the hotel one more time.

Revere Hotel Boston Common still has the Premium Room with two queen beds for Friday January 22 through Tuesday January 26, four nights. The occupancy limit is four, so Marcus, Daniel, and Owen are covered, and both queen beds are fixed beds. The total remains $1,430.96 including taxes and mandatory fees. Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Wednesday January 20; after that, the full stay is charged.
What does that put the trip at before food and whatever we do while we're there? Keep the celebration transportation in it.

Airfare plus hotel is $2,324.96. Allow $46.60-$59.60 for the planned local transportation: airport-to-hotel transit Friday, transit to and from the Saturday celebration at 10 Garden Street, and a Tuesday rideshare to Logan. That makes the expected booked-trip baseline $2,371.56-$2,384.56 before meals, activities, bags, seat fees, and incidental rides.
And Tuesday isn't too tight? I don't want a theoretical rideshare plan at five in the morning.

It is workable with a scheduled pickup. For the 7:10 a.m. departure, set the rideshare for 4:55 a.m. Tuesday and be in the lobby by 4:50. The drive from the Revere to Logan is generally about 15-25 minutes at that hour, putting you at the terminal around 5:15-5:25, roughly 1 hour 45 minutes before departure. Prebook it Monday evening and use the hotel desk to call a taxi if the assigned driver drops.
Good. Book the 6:55 outbound, the 7:10 Tuesday return, and the Revere room for all three of us.

I have the passenger names and payment details already entered. Final purchase check: JetBlue is $894 total and nonrefundable, with cancellation value issued as travel credit; the Revere is $1,430.96, cancelable without charge only through 6:00 p.m. Eastern January 20, then subject to the full-stay penalty. Shall I submit both charges?

Booked. JetBlue confirmation J7R4NX covers Marcus, Daniel, and Owen on ORD-BOS Friday January 22, 6:55-10:13 a.m., and BOS-ORD Tuesday January 26, 7:10-9:13 a.m. The Blue airfare total is $894; checked bags and paid seat selections are excluded. Revere Hotel confirmation RV-621847 is for a Premium Room with two queen beds, four nights January 22-26, for $1,430.96 total. It accommodates all three travelers. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. Eastern Wednesday January 20, after which the full stay is due. Airfare and lodging total $2,324.96; with the planned local transportation, expect $2,371.56-$2,384.56 before meals and activities. Leave the hotel at 12:40 p.m. Saturday for the 2:00 celebration. Schedule Tuesday's Logan pickup for 4:55 a.m., be downstairs at 4:50, and use the hotel taxi fallback if needed.
